classification.difficultyReason: Requires a dependent chain of corresponding angles, supplementary angles and two quadrilateral angle sums, with full reasons.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals. Provide full reasoning.

spec.description: Unshaded outer quadrilateral ACDF with B on AC, E on FD, internal BE, G on BE and H on CD. GH joins G and H. Matching upward arrowheads mark AF parallel to BE; GH has no parallel marker.
spec.mathematics: A, B, C are collinear; B, G, E are collinear; C, H, D are collinear; F, E, D are collinear. AF is parallel to BE. Given angles: AFE=110°, BGH=120°, BCD=70°, EDH=100°. Unknowns: x=GED, y=CBG, z=CHG. Coordinates preserve the source's schematic proportions rather than asserting a scale construction.
spec.answerVisibility: Only source givens and unknown labels are visible. No calculated angles or answers appear in the question diagram.

answer.short: $x=110^{\circ},\ z=90^{\circ},\ y=80^{\circ}$. Corresponding angles give $x$; use straight-line and quadrilateral angle sums for $z$ and $y$.
answer.worked:
Since $AF\parallel BE$, corresponding angles give
$$\begin{align*}x&=110^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
Angles on the straight line $BGE$ give
$$\begin{align*}\angle EGH+120^{\circ}&=180^{\circ}\\\angle EGH&=60^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
The angles in quadrilateral $EGHD$ sum to $360^{\circ}$:
$$\begin{align*}\angle GHD+60^{\circ}+110^{\circ}+100^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\angle GHD+270^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\\angle GHD&=90^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
Angles on the straight line $CHD$ give
$$\begin{align*}z+90^{\circ}&=180^{\circ}\\z&=90^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
The angles in quadrilateral $BCHG$ sum to $360^{\circ}$:
$$\begin{align*}y+70^{\circ}+90^{\circ}+120^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\y+280^{\circ}&=360^{\circ}\\y&=80^{\circ}.\end{align*}$$
